Senses.PreferredTarget: act as though no one else were present
AlternateTargets: carry on with no regard for anyone nearby
Senses.Note: Four comments on named conduct support “act as though no one else were present” in four independent works.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云：藥山探頭太過，傍若無人。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X69/X69n1368.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yanxi Guangwen (偃溪廣聞禪師語錄). English Label: Yanxi Guangwen comments that Yaoshan sticks his head out too far and acts as though nobody else were present.

Occurrences.Kwic: 指佛殿。老子傍若無人。到處稱尊。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n2000.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xutang (虛堂和尚語錄). English Label: Xutang Zhiyu points at the buddha hall and says that the old fellow behaves as if alone, claiming honor everywhere.

Occurrences.Kwic: 居天下之廣居，阿誰無分？正諲祖之正位，傍若無人。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J37/J37nB388.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Shending Yikui (神鼎一揆禪師語錄). English Label: Shending Yikui speaks of occupying the ancestral position as though no one else were present. Roster-linked exact speaker: Yikui Yuankui.

Occurrences.Kwic: 雲居舜云：諸人作麼生會？有底道：首座落他綣繢。與麼會又爭得？山僧道：趙州大似傍若無人。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1296.xml). Collected Ancient Cases of the Lineage (宗門拈古彙集). English Label: Yunju Shun asks how the assembly understands the case and says that Zhaozhou greatly resembles someone acting as though nobody were present.

Senses.Explanation: Act as though no one else were present makes a comparison without claiming that the setting is literally empty. Yanxi applies it after saying Yaoshan stuck his head out too far; Xutang applies it to 'the old fellow' claiming honor everywhere; Shending places it beside occupying the ancestral position; and Yunju Shun applies it to Zhaozhou in a cited case.
